location_description: Ann Arbor is a city in the U.S. state of Michigan and the county seat of Washtenaw County.  The 2020 census recorded its population to be 123,851. It is the principal city of the Ann Arbor Metropolitan Statistical Area, which encompasses all of Washtenaw County.
